def fruit_distribution(s, n):
    
    lis = list()
    for i in s.split(' '):
        if i.isdigit():
            lis.append(int(i))
    return n - sum(lis)

# Unit test for function fruit_distribution
def test_fruit_distribution():
    # Basic case with two numbers in the string
    assert fruit_distribution("5 apples and 6 oranges", 19) == 8
    # Case where one count is zero
    assert fruit_distribution("0 apples and 1 oranges", 3) == 2
    # Larger total value
    assert fruit_distribution("2 apples and 3 oranges", 100) == 95
    # Larger counts in the string
    assert fruit_distribution("100 apples and 1 oranges", 120) == 19
    # Numbers in different positions within the string
    assert fruit_distribution("apples 12 and oranges 24", 50) == 14
    # Single number mentioned in the string
    assert fruit_distribution("10 mangoes only", 25) == 15
    # No numbers at all in the string
    assert fruit_distribution("just fruits here", 7) == 7
    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fruit_distribution()

def test_fruit_distribution():
    # Basic cases
    assert fruit_distribution("5 apples and 6 oranges", 19) == 8
    assert fruit_distribution("5 apples and 6 oranges", 21) == 10
    assert fruit_distribution("0 apples and 1 oranges", 3) == 2
    assert fruit_distribution("1 apples and 0 oranges", 3) == 2
    assert fruit_distribution("2 apples and 3 oranges", 100) == 95
    assert fruit_distribution("100 apples and 1 oranges", 120) == 19

    # Edge cases
    assert fruit_distribution("apples and oranges", 10) == 10      # no digits in string
    assert fruit_distribution("", 5) == 5                          # empty string
    assert fruit_distribution("0 apples and 0 oranges", 0) == 0    # zero total
    assert fruit_distribution("7", 7) == 0                         # single number, all accounted for

    # Multiple numbers in string
    assert fruit_distribution("10 apples 20 oranges 5 bananas", 100) == 65

    # Negative result possible (more counted fruits than total)
    assert fruit_distribution("5 apples and 6 oranges", 10) == -1

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fruit_distribution()
